name: Dor Ben Dor
lockedText: You may not enter the Studio until you took classes from both Yakir and David.

yield.speech: Huff...|Puff....|I see....|A game designer's wits don't come from the way they fight...|But the way they think about how games work....|.....|So even after everything I threw at you....|You are still standing.....|......
yield.flawlessLine: With not a single point of damage taken....
yield.closing: ........|I yield.....|I leave the decision on what to do next in your hands.

actOptions.name: Check
actOptions.description: Dor Ben Dor - 100 Health, 5 Attack. The decision on what to do now, rests in your hands

battleDialogue.onEncounter: So, you've finally made it to my studio.|Most students don't get this far.|I hope you're ready - this is the final test of everything you've learned at Tiltan.|Let's see if you truly have what it takes to be a Game Designer.
onAttack: This will reduce your score on Canvas.
My portfolio won't be affected by this.
Don't expect me to help you with your Final Project!
This is why you can't make a good game.
onAct: You know...|After the thousands of students I have taught here in Tiltan|I don't think I have seen more potential here than you|You have some energy emitting from you...
This generation of students is really pissing me off....|None of you students have the potential to even be successful in the market.|If you keep making platformers, you surely won't get anywhere
You know|At this point...|I don't care about you escaping this place.
Being a Game Designer is a commitment. A test of your might|Prove to me with this next attack that you truly are a Game Designer.
Hmph.|Most students were not able to reach to this point.|Your endurance and skill are impressive.|But don't get too comfortable.

The world of game creation is a cruel mistress.|Creating games is not only a craft, but an art.|It shows the nature of your character.|Who is the person behind making games?|This next attack, hopefully, will show you what good game design can achieve.

Knowing how to make games is not enough.|Always ask yourself: What is the purpose of this game?|What is the player supposed to feel when playing this game?|What is the player supposed to learn from this game?|This next attack will show you what good game design can achieve.
I truly am starting to get impressed with you.|I usually just kick students out of Tiltan when they reach this point.|But you have shown me that you are a student with potential.

One of my main goals as a Game Designer teachers is to reduce slop.|What we are missing right now are good games.|You might have the potential to make a good one.|But I am not counting on it.|At the end of the day, students can't deliver.
battleDialogue.onSpared: You truly are remakable.|You survived everything I threw at you, yet you still show mercy?|I shouldn't have been so harsh with you.|Thank you for giving me a chance to see the world through your eyes.|I will let you go, but I hope you will remember this lesson for the rest of your life.

opening: Let me show you what we ship at Cloverbyte.
You've seen this one already. Let's add a step.
You know both rules now. Keep up.
Cloverbyte will be a successful studio when you are not in its way.
With each game Cloverbyte releases, we only get richer and richer.
blue: BLUE means you hold still. Were you not listening?

moves.name: Chess
moves.description: Dor Ben Dor sets the board.

opening: Again. This time I add a piece.
You have earned a queen. Congratulations.
Six pieces. Still think this is a game?
Two queens. I am done being generous.
The full rank. No more lessons.
landing: Commitment. That is what this tests.
The ocean shows no mercy. Neither do I.
Soon all the world shall know this board.
cleared: You took my queen. Do not enjoy it.
You cleared it. Truly splendid movement.
survived: Survival is not skill. Anyone can wait.
Hiding is not a strategy. It is a delay.
A whole turn of nothing. Impressive.
You survive. You do not win. Learn that.
You endure. The storm does not tire.

moves.name: Boat
moves.description: Dor Ben Dor calls up the boat.

opening: This boat is the only thing my sister and I ever agreed on.
We fought over who got to keep it. I won.

moves.name: Napoleon
moves.description: The room falls away and something enormous rises.
moves.intro: Hmph.|You truly are a remarkable student.|But lets see you face against my ultimate attack.

descriptionByHp.text: Dor Ben Dor - HP 100, ATK 5. The final boss of Tiltan. | Seems like trying to spare him is a waste of time.

extraMessages: He starts to get excited.|RPGs are one of his favourite generes.|This did not affect his SPARE score.

extraMessages: Dor Ben Dor nods at the student council.|They just leave you.....|This did not affect his SPARE score

spareSuccessText: Dor Ben Dor nods and allows you passage.

spareTextByPercent.text: Dor Ben Dor has no intention of letting you pass.
